=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:the new "Record GH_PAT budget at <job> start" / "Record GH_PAT budget at <job> end" steps in the seven PAT-holding release-gate jobs (e.g. lines 671-682 start / 3456-3481 end for e2e-smoke-test; same pair in e2e-alt-model-test, validate-standalone-test, workflow-log-analysis-test, orphan-workflows-test, orchestrate-decompose-test, clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Each start and end step runs `gh api rate_limit` (`reading="$(gh api rate_limit --jq ...)"`), adding 14 GitHub API requests per test-and-mark-stable run. This breaks the issue's "no new API calls and no new jobs. Part A adds zero calls" and "No API calls added". The `validate` job (lines ~5893-5897, ~6019-6031) already shows the compliant pattern: it makes no API call and prints `remaining=unknown reset=unknown used_in_job=unknown`.
  WHY: This is a spec-constraint violation, not a crash. `gh_helpers.sh` documents that `/rate_limit` does not debit the core REST allowance, so the practical harm is small (14 requests per 6-hourly run). The fix is cheap: copy the `validate`-job pattern by skipping the `rate_limit` read, printing quota keys as `unknown`, and keeping `calls_in_job` numeric.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
